data.body:
J1 acb2 ORACLE AUTHORED (test-only story; orchestrator-authored by design — J1's deliverable IS the oracle).
Extended tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_backend_characterization.py: 9 -> 30 tests (+259 lines). Exact-value pins added for every unit J2 moves or re-points:
 - map_fields_to_remote: all 5 branches (title->summary, description via ADF fit+normalize, status, priority, passthrough) INCLUDING both value-map defaults ('To Do'/'Medium'), the isinstance(str) description guard (None must not reach the ADF encoder), and the empty-dict case.
 - sanitizers at/below/above limits: summary inclusive max 254 (255 truncates), label inclusive max 255 (256 raises), comment 32767 boundary + truncation marker, plus _sanitize_label raising on all four rejection reasons (internal whitespace / comma / empty-after-strip / oversize). The deliberate 254-vs-255 off-by-one is pinned on both sides.
 - JiraIdentityConvention: format/parse/predicate incl. the LEGACY 'rebar-id-' hyphen read form and empty-remainder rejection.
 - classify_probe_response: every branch (404/410/403 archived; 401/5xx unreachable; 200+resolved-name; 200+other; 200 with no status; unknown code -> unreachable+unknown flag) with exact detail dicts; RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES frozenset pinned.
 - _RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK full vocabulary + the ABSENCE of duplicates/supersedes/discovered_from; resolve_inbound_link direction for every relation incl. inward-Blocks inversion and the (None,None) malformed cases.
RESULT: 30/30 green against unmodified src (characterization, so GREEN-now is correct — these pin EXISTING behavior; the RED-first discipline applies to J2+ where new behavior is built).

MUTATION CHECK (J1 AC #3) — all three proven RED, sources restored, tree clean (only the test file modified):
 1. outbound_fields._LOCAL_TO_JIRA_STATUS['blocked'] 'In Progress'->'To Do' => 2 FAILED (test_outbound_status_value_map_pins_all_states, test_map_fields_to_remote_maps_every_status_plus_unmapped_default).
 2. probe.classify_probe_response drops 403 from the archived branch => 1 FAILED (test_classify_probe_response_pins_every_branch).
 3. identity._READ_PREFIXES drops legacy 'rebar-id-' => 2 FAILED (test_identity_parse_label_accepts_colon_and_legacy_hyphen_forms, test_identity_is_identity_label_tracks_parse).

FINDING (emergent, from a mutation that FAILED to go red on the first attempt): the local->Jira status/priority value maps exist in TWO copies that have ALREADY DRIFTED:
 - adapters/jira/jira_fields.py: _LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA / _LOCAL_PRIORITY_TO_JIRA — read ONLY by the ACLI transport (acli.py:69-70,143,171; acli_cli_ops.py:34,343,354).
 - adapters/jira/outbound_fields.py: _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_STATUS / _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_PRIORITY — read by the Backend port (backend.py map_fields_to_remote).
 The drift: outbound_fields' status map has a 'deleted': 'Done' entry that jira_fields' does NOT. My first mutation edited the jira_fields copy and the suite stayed GREEN — i.e. the ACLI-side copy is unpinned by the backend oracle. This is exactly the duplication the epic exists to remove, and it means the epic's 'no mapping logic in two places' AC has a pre-existing violation INSIDE adapters/jira/ (not just Cloud-vs-DC). Filing as a discovered_from ticket.
